description:
The Python pack's bundle manifest, `bundle.toml` (SPEC.md "The Python pack and its
bundle"): what `rascal tools setup` verifies before it installs. Every file in the bundle
is listed with its digest; nothing else is installed.

files.description: Every file in the bundle by relative path, with its `sha256:<hex>` digest.

models.description:
Whether the model artifacts `artifacts.toml` names are in the bundle under `models/`
(a bundle without them serves `echo_region` only).

python.description: The interpreter line the bundle was built for (`3.12`).

wheel.description: The pack wheel's path inside the bundle.

title: BundleManifest
